seo.title: Shreyas Patange | Software Engineer
seo.description: Software engineer at Skylark Labs building multi-region video infrastructure and agentic AI systems in Go and TypeScript.

bio: I'm a software engineer at Skylark Labs working on distributed systems and agentic AI. I built a multi-region video platform that handles thousands of concurrent live camera streams, then built an agentic layer on top of it that lets people query more than a million surveillance events in plain language.

On the infrastructure side I own the real-time pipeline: **RTSP** ingest, **FFmpeg** and **OpenCV** processing, **gRPC** service boundaries, **WebRTC** delivery, and the **Envoy** and **Maglev** routing that keeps streams pinned to nodes without hotspots. On the AI side I work in TypeScript with **Mastra**, combining hybrid retrieval, structured queries, tool calling, and memory.

Agents are only as reliable as the systems underneath them, which is why I like working on both. I do my best work on small teams with real ownership. Outside work I built **Gor**, an interpreted language in Go, and I compete on LeetCode.

bullets: Built a **multi-region distributed system** for **RTSP/WebRTC** video ingestion, egress, and processing in **TypeScript**, **Go**, **OpenCV**, **FFmpeg**, and **gRPC**, sustaining **10K+ concurrent live streams** with real-time analytics at **sub-400ms p95** end-to-end latency.

Developed an **agentic AI platform** with **Mastra** and **TypeScript**: hybrid retrieval (metadata filtering, semantic search, structured querying), tool calling, contextual memory, and autonomous workflows, enabling natural-language analytics over **1M+** surveillance events and cutting manual review time by **60%**.

Implemented **Envoy** and **Traefik** load balancing for **gRPC** and **HTTP** services with **Maglev consistent hashing**, distributing **10K+** live streams across processing nodes and enabling **A/B deployments** on **Kubernetes** and **Docker**.

Designed a centralized **identity and access management** platform with **OAuth2**, **JWT** authentication, organization management, licensing, and fine-grained **RBAC**, serving multiple internal services and handling **100K+** auth and licensing requests monthly.

Managed **multi-region AWS infrastructure** (**Kubernetes**, **ECS**, **Lambda**, **RDS**) behind **Cloudflare global load balancing**, with **Terraform** IaC, **CI/CD** pipelines, and observability via **Prometheus**, **Grafana**, and **Loki**.
Improved reliability with **AWS SQS/SNS** distributed queues and built the real-time alerting stack (WebSockets, push, email, SMS), delivering **100K+ alerts/day** at **under 2s** median latency.

Led a team of **5 engineers**; built an **AI-powered real-time voice agent** and **WhatsApp agent** with **LangChain** and **Twilio**, handling **100+ conversations/day** through **BullMQ** workflows and automating **70%** of inquiries end to end.
Developed a **serverless microservice architecture** on **AWS Lambda** with **DynamoDB**, **TypeScript**, and **CloudFront**, deployed via the **Serverless Framework**.
Optimized frontend performance with **Next.js** **SSG/SSR** and server actions for type-safe **RPC** calls.

Architected an HR platform backend with **NestJS**, **Prisma**, and **PostgreSQL**: shift management, biometric attendance, and payroll generation for **100+ employees**, with real-time notifications via **Firebase** and **WebSockets**.
